title: ToolTime tool.yaml: params.<name>.bounds extension (proposal)
description: Additive extension to pho3nix_config/tool.yaml. Only the parts of tool.yaml this proposal touches are constrained; every other key is left open, so a tool.yaml with no bounds stays valid. Cross-field rules that JSON Schema cannot express (min < max, the range inside the param's hard minimum/maximum, rendered values inside enum, integer-valued min/max being int rather than 5.0) are enforced by validate_bounds.py, which is stricter than this schema.

params.description: Existing ToolTime shape: a mapping of param name -> spec, or null.

param.description: An existing param spec (required, type, description, default, enum, flag, validation, minimum, maximum, ...). Only the optional bounds key is new.

bounds.description: Tuning search space for one param. Distinct from the param's hard validity limits (minimum/maximum): bounds say which values an automated tuner may try, and must sit inside the hard limits.

max.description: Highest gene value (inclusive). Must be > min (validator-enforced).

unit.description: Unit of the gene value, e.g. threads, ms, s, requests/s.

direction.description: What raising the value does to load on the target. A physical property of the tool, not an optimisation objective.

evolvable.description: true = the catalog owner permits unattended automated search over [min, max]. Consumers may restrict further.

value_template.description: How a numeric gene becomes the param value, e.g. '-T{value}' or '{value}ms'. Required for string params; exactly one {value} placeholder, no other braces.

rationale.description: Why these numbers; cite profiles, upstream defaults, or docs.

source.description: Where the numbers came from (file, doc, flag help).
